messages.author: 6303bca1668d79af
messages.subject: PyStan 2.12.0.0 available on PyPI
parts:
PyStan 2.12.0.0 is now available on PyPI:

https://pypi.python.org/pypi/pystan

Wheels are available on all platforms.

============
What's New
============

V2.12.0.0 (15. Sept 2016)

- Update Stan source to v2.12.0 (release notes)
- #239 Fix bug in array indexing (thanks @stephen-hoover)
- #254 Fix off-by-one error in estimated sample size calculation
